sentences.text:
Shri Anand Soni - Additional Advocate General for th
State.
The appellant has filed this appeal against the order passed by Food Safety Appellate Tribunal established under Section 70.
The appeal lies under Sub-section (6) of Section 71 before this High Court.
The appellant has wrongly filed this appeal under Section 76 under which the appeal lies against the order passed under Section 74 of Special Court.
The appellant is directed to carry out the amendment in the memo of appeal and thereafter the office is directed to list before appropriate Bench.
